title: ソフトウェアモデリング
subtitle: Software Modeling
educationalGoal: In this course, students will achieve the following learning objectives: 1. Understand the basic concepts of software design, with a focus on object-oriented development. 2. Gain fundamental knowledge of UML as a software design description language. 3. Develop practical software design skills through the design and implementation process.
advice: To develop software for information processing systems, it is necessary to follow a series of processes, including system requirements analysis, system analysis, system design, system construction, software design and implementation, system verification, and operational testing. In order to understand the importance of software design, students need to gain hands-on experience with design activities as part of the system development process. In this course, students will learn object-oriented development through practical exercises using UML and the Java programming language. The main topics covered in this course are as follows: 1. Overview of object-oriented concepts 2. Object-oriented development process 3. Analysis, design, and modeling using UML 4. Program development using Java Note: Students are required to bring their own laptop computer and the designated textbook to each class.
books: Textbooks: 実践UMLによるシステム開発ー事例で学ぶ「オブジェクト指向」のシステム設計[工学社] Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Students are expected to have reviewed and understood the following topics covered in Programming II (Java Basics) and Programming III (Object-Oriented Programming). 1. Ability to explain basic object-oriented concepts, such as classes, methods, objects, and inheritance. 2. Ability to read and explain example source code. 3. Ability to create, compile, and execute a simple object-oriented Java program. 4. Basic ability to program in Python and to use SQL databases.

activityGoals.body: Explain key terms and concepts related to object-oriented programming.
Describe the system development process using UML.
Understand the meanings of graphical symbols in UML diagrams, and create and use UML diagrams appropriately.
Define and implement classes using the Java programming language.
Explain the terminology associated with representative software testing techniques.
Create UML design diagrams based on program implementations.
